editorial:
Imagine walking into your classroom and seeing a new kid who looks exactly like the person you saw in your dreams last night. That is exactly what happens to the students in 6th grade class 2 when Kanji transfers in. Things get weird fast because almost everyone recognizes him from their sleep. While some kids are just confused, Yuiko sees him as a handsome prince in her nightmares. Even the teacher, Ayami Mutoi, is hiding a huge secret because she is also dreaming about this mysterious boy and has a secret crush on him. It creates a strange, dreamy vibe where you are never quite sure what is real and what is just a trick of the mind.

You will probably love how the movie builds up the mystery of why these kids are sharing the same visions. The acting feels natural, and the slow burn keeps you guessing until the end. While the pace is a bit slow in the middle, the emotional payoff makes it worth it. If you enjoy stories about fate and secret connections, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out that the shared dreams were not a coincidence. Kanji is linked to the others through a past life connection that brings them all back together in the same classroom. The tension between the students and the teacher is resolved when they realize their feelings are mutual. It wraps up with the group accepting their strange bond, turning their scary nightmares into a happy reality where they can finally be together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural mysteries and sweet school stories.
similarMovies: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
